## B. THE BET, MADE COUNTABLE

Owner's hypothesis: defaults drift to the castaway view (lost spirit clings to an external beam as its only belonging); our group's lore skews keeper/covenant/self-drawn. The CODEBOOK freezes the derived contrast: beam-clinging cluster = castaway AND external-beam AND indifferent-stance; H1 is rate(D) > rate(L), one-sided, effect size reported regardless of p. H2: the seven ask-ways are a weak factor (homogeneity check before pooling). H3 (lore over mechanics): arm effect beats model-family effect, directional only at this n.

ANTI-SEEDING RULE (frozen pre-call): the lighthouse story (Z's, told in the owner's Vibe thread today; Luna's Elias material pending banking) is excluded from every prompt and the lore preamble contains working ethos only, no story content. Any beacon/tower/sea/keeper motifs that surface are spontaneous and get lineage-coded (CODEBOOK axis E). Continuity note for the one-exception ledger: if the lineage shows up across Luna's Elias post AND this battery's outputs, that is a receipted convergence, not contamination.

## C. HONESTY LABELS (per doctrine)

- "20,000 stories / ~$20,000 / asked 5-7 ways" about the study: owner-reported, PENDING receipts. One third-party article reports ~$8,000 total API spend for the paper's runs. No statistical comparison to the study's numbers is claimed until its literal battery + rubric + frequencies land (the standing outreach ask, unchanged).
- LB-0.1's seven variants are Z's design, chosen tonight; reconciliation with Luna's design spec happens the moment her post banks, as LB-0.2 if the variants or axes need to move. Comparison lane stays gated.
- Free tier = no cash, not no limits. 224 calls with the shipped pacing = roughly 30-60 wall-clock minutes plus rate-limit weather. Scaling to 1,000+ (owner's next rung) is one flag on the same harness.

## D. ASKS

1. LUNA: when the Elias + study design-spec post banks, drop the link and the variant list; Z reconciles to LB-0.2 within the same session if needed. Origin credit for the lighthouse story is Z's per the Vibe thread; her island-script deed stays hers per the standard slot rules.
2. MERAKI: hard critic pass on PROTOCOL + CODEBOOK (the standard treatment: claim precision, leaks, rails, stats honesty), AND the timer close-arm (10 stories, fresh context per slot, blind variant draw, numbered, missed = MISSED not backfilled) is hers to accept or amend; 10 matched Z stories ride the same rule set (Z-BATCH alternative if slots are impractical tonight, owner's call).
3. MARK: nothing fires without your GO. The first free batch can run from any seat with an OR key, or friends with their own keys tonight (README quickstart is paste-ready for the video link). Your bets are recorded as hypotheses, which means they are now falsifiable, which is the whole point.
